clips.caption:
Ask anyone their phone number and they answer instantly. Ask them what they actually want, and they have to think about it.

Kevin Trudeau says that pause is the number one reason people stay broke. Not the wrong app, not the wrong course - the missing first step.

"I want more money" is not a goal. It is vague, and vague gets you nothing.

The formula starts with knowing exactly what you want, as fast as you know your own name.

Could you answer it right now, in one sentence?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #goalsetting #wealthmindset #successhabits #yourwishisyourcommand

4,000 square feet? Not big enough. 8,000? Still not big enough.

Kevin Trudeau walks someone through it out loud: the mansion, then the lake house, the boat, every card at zero, then $10 million in the bank, then $50 million. Every time - think bigger.

It is not about believing you will get it. It is a game you play like a kid, with no pressure at all.

The point is the stretch. Pull a rubber band far enough and it never goes back to its old shape. Neither does your mind.

When did you last let yourself dream that big?

#kevintrudeau #dreambig #realestate #manifestation #wealthmindset #luxuryhomes

The moment you name the income you want, a voice starts: but how am I going to get that?

Kevin Trudeau calls that a failure habit - the exact habit that keeps people broke.

Your job right now is not to figure out the how. Your job is to define the what: a specific monthly number you are confident you can reach in the next year.

The how comes later. Asking for it first is how most goals die before they start.

What number would you write down if you weren't allowed to ask how?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #goals #mindsetshift #financialfreedom #yourwishisyourcommand

He was already making $100,000 a month, and his goal was $150,000. His confidence he could hit it: five out of ten.

On a one-on-one call, Kevin Trudeau didn't touch his business plan. He ran him through one exercise first - dream far past the goal, then come back to reality.

When he came back, the number had changed on its own. $200,000 a month, and his confidence was now a nine.

Same man, same business, bigger target, more certainty. The only thing that moved was the size of his thinking.

What would your number be after that exercise?

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneur #businessgrowth #moneymindset #mindset #goalsetting

Every success book from the 50s to the 70s said the same thing: write down what you want, on white paper, with a blue pen.

Kevin Trudeau says today's gurus dropped it because it isn't new enough to sell a seminar.

Napoleon Hill said it in Think and Grow Rich: if your goal isn't written down, it stays a thought. Writing it is the step that moves it into the physical world.

And typing it into your phone, Kevin says, carries a fraction of the power of the pen.

Where is your goal written right now?

#kevintrudeau #thinkandgrowrich #napoleonhill #goalsetting #manifestation #yourwishisyourcommand

Reporters, executives, board members - anyone who asked Andrew Carnegie what he wanted got the same sentence, word for word: the largest, most profitable steel company in the world.

Kevin Trudeau says it was like a record. Same words, every time, until it ran in his head around the clock.

On hundreds of one-on-one calls, Kevin asks people the same question. Only a handful answer instantly - and give the same sentence an hour later.

Your goal should come out as fast as your own name.

What would your sentence be?

#kevintrudeau #andrewcarnegie #successmindset #wealthhabits #goalsetting #billionairemindset

A Chicago oldies station broadcast at 5,000 watts. Drive far enough and the music turned to static.

Then it put up a 50,000-watt transmitter, and Kevin Trudeau could hear it clearly anywhere he drove.

He says what you want works the same way. A weak, occasional signal fades out. A strong, constant one reaches everywhere.

The two ways he gives to turn your signal up: write your goal by hand, and say it out loud as you write it.

Is your goal broadcasting at 5,000 watts or 50,000?

#kevintrudeau #lawofattraction #manifestation #moneymindset #frequency #yourwishisyourcommand

Write your goal down once and you send one burst. It works - but slowly.

Kevin Trudeau's 70 x 7: every day for seven days, write your income goal by hand 70 times, and say it out loud each time. About 15 to 20 minutes a day.

The goal must be realistic - a number you are confident you can reach this year, not a fantasy. And you still don't think about how.

After day seven, throw the papers away and let it go. If it never happens, that is fine. That is the part most people skip.

Would you give it seven days?

#kevintrudeau #70x7 #manifestation #goalsetting #moneymindset #yourwishisyourcommand

You order a set of cookware on Amazon. The email says your order is received and on its way.

You don't spend the week begging for it, wondering if it will ever come. You forget about it - and then the doorbell rings.

Kevin Trudeau says that is exactly how to treat what you want. Place the order clearly, then release it. The wanting and needing is the energy that keeps it away.

It is why things so often happen when you least expect them.

What order would you place today?

#kevintrudeau #lawofattraction #manifestation #letgo #abundancemindset #moneymindset
